title: dailyrewardslite
description: DailyRewardsLite is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that allows players to claim daily rewards through a GUI, supports reward display, cooldown tracking, player permission management, and is easy to install on a server.
body:
DailyRewardsLite is a lightweight and modern Minecraft plugin that provides players with a simple daily reward system through an intuitive GUI interface. Designed for performance and ease of use, it allows server owners to reward player activity with configurable rewards and persistent cooldown tracking.

Built using the latest API standards, the plugin ensures smooth integration with modern Paper servers and delivers a clean user experience without unnecessary complexity.
